mapping.description: Each row is a module listed by Sysinternals ListDLLs for a process observed at collection time, with process name, identifier, command line, module path, base address, and size. Use it to detect unexpected DLL loads and correlate modules with processes and hashes from other artifacts. It is a transient snapshot; absent or terminated processes are not represented and process identifiers can be reused.
mapping.short_description: Shows DLLs loaded by running processes with process IDs, command lines, module paths, base addresses, and sizes.

field.description: Full command line used to start the process
Base address in memory where the DLL is loaded (hexadecimal)
Size of the DLL module in memory
Full path to the DLL file on disk
